# Tuiport

> Build real SSH apps with OpenTUI, run the same container locally or on Cloudflare, and connect from any terminal with ordinary SSH.

Canonical site: https://tuiport.coey.dev
Source: https://github.com/acoyfellow/tuiport
License: MIT

## Documentation

- [Tutorial](https://tuiport.coey.dev/tutorial): Deploy the Cloudflare application and connect a public SSH hostname.
- [How-to guides](https://tuiport.coey.dev/how-to): Customize the OpenTUI app, authentication, and domains.
- [Reference](https://tuiport.coey.dev/reference): Worker routes, ports, resources, configuration, and lifecycle.
- [Explanation](https://tuiport.coey.dev/explanation): How raw SSH TCP flows from Spectrum through a Worker connect() handler into the Container.

## Architecture

OpenSSH → Cloudflare Spectrum (worker origin) → Worker connect() → Durable Object connect() → Cloudflare Container → @opentui/ssh.

Every hop splices encrypted SSH bytes; nothing runs outside Cloudflare.
